patch_summary: Confined unstream_dir() extraction to target_directory: added _is_safe_archive_name() (rejects absolute paths, drive-letter paths, and any '..' member component) and _is_within_directory() checks (lexical abspath plus realpath to block writes/chmod/utime through escaping symlinks, CWE-59); unsafe members are skipped. Symlink creation itself is preserved so legitimate round-trips (e.g. absolute-link test fixtures) keep working.
root_cause: unstream_dir() joined unsanitized zip member names onto target_directory and passed them to archive.extract()/os.utime()/os.chmod(), and recreated symlinks with unvalidated targets, so a crafted zip could write files and chmod/utime files outside target_directory, including writes through an in-target symlink pointing outside (CWE-22/CWE-59).
